children: MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The board of directors of Target Corporation (

) has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.16 per common share.  The dividend is payable December 1, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business November 11, 2026.  The fourth quarter dividend will be the company's 237th consecutive dividend paid since October 1967 when the company became publicly held.

) brings together style, design and value to offer a distinct assortment and elevated shopping experience across more than 2,000 U.S. stores and online. Powered by more than 400,000 team members, Target serves millions of families each week and invests in the communities where they live and work to support growth and opportunity for all.
